mechanism_narrative: The four-week improvement in RETAIL_REC from -32.3 to -21.9, accompanied by rising TRANSIT and WORKPLACES, reflects a reopening momentum that will continue over the next four weeks and lift RETAIL_REC above its last-28-day mean.
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to -26.375 despite TRANSIT and WORKPLACES continuing to improve.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM falls below +10 percent from baseline, precautionary shopping diminishes and consumers reallocate trips to retail and recreation, raising RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below +10 percent from baseline for one week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise above its last-28-day mean within two weeks after GROCERY_PHARM falls below +10 percent.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in RESIDENTIAL from +16.4 to +10.6 and rise in TRANSIT from -31.7 to -23.0 indicates a coordinated return to out-of-home activity; this interaction will drive RETAIL_REC higher over the next week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below +12 and TRANSIT rises above -24
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is lower than its last-28-day mean even when RESIDENTIAL is below +12 and TRANSIT is above -24.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of steady reopening with partial restrictions, a week-on-week improvement in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES greater than 2 points signals increased commuting and commercial activity that will lift RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves by more than 2 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its last-28-day mean when TRANSIT improves by more than 2 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: Prolonged elevated RESIDENTIAL above +10 for three consecutive weeks combined with WORKPLACES recovering above -18 signals lockdown fatigue and a return to commuting that will spill over into retail trips, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above +10 for three consecutive weeks and WORKPLACES rises above -18
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is not higher than its last-28-day mean when RESIDENTIAL stays above +10 for three consecutive weeks and WORKPLACES rises above -18.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal cooling in September reduces PARKS mobility from -27.4 to -29.3, shifting outdoor recreation demand indoors to retail venues and raising RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS declines by more than 1 point week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than its last-28-day mean when PARKS declines by more than 1 point week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction of GROCERY_PHARM rising above +13 and TRANSIT declining week-on-week signals renewed pandemic precaution and impending restrictions, which will suppress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM exceeds +13 and TRANSIT declines week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than its last-28-day mean when GROCERY_PHARM exceeds +13 and TRANSIT declines week-on-week.
